description: Sets the percent complete of an existing task (0-100), replacing the previous value. Requires write permission.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

task.description: Task reference: its key (the 'rif' column, e.g. 'Cronos-12'), its uuid, 'wbs:1.2', or its exact name if unique.

name: planitude_set_progress
title: Set task progress
